entity.description: The Coastal Arts Center of Orange Beach is a multi-studio campus that overlooks scenic Wolf Bay and offers many artistic experiences with a breathtaking view. The stunning 10,000 square foot fine art gallery features a spacious two-story building displaying works by Gulf Coast artists including watercolorists, potters, painters, photographers, sculptors and textile artists. The Hot Shop is Alabama's premier hot glass blowing studio where visitors can make their own glass piece. The Clay Studio features ceramics artist Maya Blume-Cantrell creating beautiful artwork from clay, with opportunities for the public to make their own pottery. Adult art classes are available at various times of the year. The center offers summer art camps and the Coastal Arts Student Academy (CASA) for kids. Free and open to the public, the gallery features beautiful works from local artists with a broad price range of original artwork. The waterfront grounds are accessible daily and visitors are welcome to bring a picnic or bring an easel to draw or paint the breathtaking surroundings. The facility is pet friendly if your pet is leashed and has good, quiet manners.

Facilities
Adult Fitness Center

The 17,400-square-foot City of Orange Beach Adult Fitness Center is open with 24-hour accessibility for members. The facility is on the Rec Center campus, behind the Community Center.

Senior Center

The Orange Beach Senior Center opened in January 2003. The center is located adjacent to the Orange Beach Library. Amenities include arts and crafts, a game room, a multi-purpose room, and a screened porch overlooking Wolf Bay. Senior adult programs are offered throughout the year by professional staff.

Aquatics Center

The Orange Beach Aquatics Center is located in South Baldwin County, within a mile of the Gulf of Mexico. Our program currently serves thousands of members annually and is designed for all ages and ability levels. In addition, the programs and services of the Orange Beach Aquatics Center are built upon and focused on enabling individuals and families to build healthy lifestyles.

Art Center

The Coastal Arts Center campus overlooks scenic Wolf Bay and offers many artistic experiences with a breathtaking view.

Community Center

The Community Center is part of a complex of buildings that include the Recreation Center, Tennis Complex, Aquatics Center, and Fitness Center. This 5,000-square-foot facility has a full-service kitchen and seats approximately 300 people. The center is available for meetings, events, and parties.

Event Center

Conveniently located in Orange Beach at the base of the Beach Express and Canal Road and easily accessible from Gulf Shores and Foley, the Event Center is home to almost 100 events annually, from corporate conferences to small trade shows as well as banquets, sporting events, seminars and more.

Golf Center

The Golf Center is located on Easy Street, just off U.S. Highway 180 (Canal Road) in Orange Beach, about one and one-fourth miles east of the Foley Beach Express exit on Canal Road.

History Museum

The building that houses the Orange Beach History Museum was originally built in 1910 as a schoolhouse. It has served as a museum since 1995 and was moved to its present location in 1999.

Library

Search the Orange Beach card catalog, renew your items, or join us for an event at the library.

Parks & Trails

While the beach is without a doubt the reason most people visit Orange Beach, there are also many Orange Beach bike trails, walking paths, parks, and green spaces to explore and enjoy.

Performing Arts Center

The City of Orange Beach Expect Excellence Theater and Orange Beach Middle/High School Theatre Program perform at the Orange Beach Performing Arts Center. The 35,000-square-foot center opened in September 2021 and includes a 710-seat main theater, and a black box theater that can seat up to 175 for intimate performances.

Recreation Center/Expect Excellence Building

All about the programs within the Recreation Center

Sportsplex

The Orange Beach Sportsplex, which opened in the spring of 2001, includes softball, baseball, and football/soccer fields as well as a 3-court sand volleyball area. It features a 1500-seat stadium with a pressbox, locker rooms, and a second concession stand.

Tennis Center

The Orange Beach Tennis Center has eight lighted hard courts that are open from 7 am to 10 pm - seven days a week. The center is also home to the Orange Beach Ladies Tennis League.

Wind & Water Learning Center

The City of Orange Beach Wind and Water Learning Center is committed to enhancing life for locals and guests by providing coastal access, facilities, equipment, and education for sailing and paddling sports.

Pickleball Complex

The Orange Beach Pickleball Complex (opening May 7, 2026) features 14 lighted courts, shade cabanas, restrooms, and a pavilion.

About

Free and open to the public, our gorgeous waterfront gallery features beautiful works from local artists including watercolor, pottery, paintings, photography, sculpture, textiles and more. Our gift shop features a broad price range of original artwork.

Unless the property has been rented for an event, the waterfront grounds are accessible daily and you are welcome to bring a picnic to enjoy or bring your easel and be inspired to draw or paint the breathtaking surroundings!

Pets: We are pet friendly if your furbaby is leashed and has good, quiet manners.

Becoming a Gallery Artist/Exhibitor 

To become an Exhibiting Artist you will need to submit three (3) works of original art to be professionally juried during our fall artist jury session. Upon positive recommendation by the jury, the artist is invited to become an exhibitor at our gallery.  Our open jury season is September/October.  

To be considered, you will need to register below and adhere to the following rules:

Applicants must be a full time resident of the Gulf Coast.
Applicants pay a one-time $25 application fee. If approved as a gallery artist, commissions are 65/35% split. Additional information about our policies and guidelines will be sent upon request.
We are a city owned facility. If approved to bring your work, you will need to purchase a business license through the Finance Department next to City Hall. You will also need to fill out a W9 form to get set up as a vendor.

Please register here if you interested in being a Gallery Artist.

Art Center History

The Coastal Arts Center was, until 2015, located in the city's first hotel. Built in 1923, as a boarding-house style hotel for men who worked in the turpentine industry, it featured 11 bedrooms and a half bath upstairs. The family lived downstairs. The facility was only accessible by water until Canal Road was completed in the 1940s. Due to severe structural damage the building was torn down in spring 2015. Historical elements collected from the hotel (columns, wood flooring, doors and windows) are featured in the new gallery.

We look forward to your visit!

Saturday: 10 am to 5 pm
Sunday: 10 am to 4 pm

Overview

VOTED BEST ART SHOW IN THE NATION BY THE READERS OF USA TODAY for TWO YEARS IN A ROW! And chosen as THE 2025 TOURISM "EVENT OF THE YEAR" BY ALABAMA GOVERNER KAY IVEY.

For more than 50 years, the Festival of Art has been our island's first rite of spring. It is a celebration of visual, literary, performing, musical and culinary arts. The show has won Best Art Show in Alabama three times in the past five years by the luxury magazine "ALABAMA" and is currently ranked in the top 100 of national fine art and design shows.

This fine arts festival is completely free with music and entertainment featured on two stages. You can be a part of it by volunteering or purchasing art through our Patron of the Arts program. There are multiple parking options.

Our next show, the 53rd Annual: March 13-March 14, 2027

Saturday: 10 am to 5 pm
Sunday: 10 am to 4 pm

Fine Artist applications are accepted on ZAPPLICATION from August 1 through October 31, 2026. 

All other vendors are by invitation only.

Overview

VOTED BEST ART SHOW IN THE NATION BY THE READERS OF USA TODAY for TWO YEARS IN A ROW! And chosen as THE 2025 TOURISM "EVENT OF THE YEAR" BY ALABAMA GOVERNER KAY IVEY.

For more than 50 years, the Festival of Art has been our island's first rite of spring. It is a celebration of visual, literary, performing, musical and culinary arts. The show has won Best Art Show in Alabama three times in the past five years by the luxury magazine "ALABAMA" and is currently ranked in the top 100 of national fine art and design shows.

This fine arts festival is completely free with music and entertainment featured on two stages. You can be a part of it by volunteering or purchasing art through our Patron of the Arts program. There are multiple parking options.

Site Map & Parking




PARKING

From the west (Gulf Shores/Foley) park at Island Church with shuttle service provided for a $5 daily rate.  OR, park at Orange Beach City Hall for a $5 daily rate. 

Note: Island Church parking is available Saturday 9:30 am to 5 pm but only 1 to 5 pm on Sunday. 

From the east on Canal Rd. (Bear Point, Caswell, etc.) park at the Orange Beach Presbyterian Church or OB Community Church near the Kids Playground.

Golf Cart Parking

There are two designated spaces for golf carts. One is adjacent to the Kids Playground. The other is on the west side of the grounds near Canal Road. Just look for signs.

Bike Village

The festival grounds will feature a special fenced-in area for our cycling guests. This is a moderately enclosed area, but we still encourage you to lock your bike to the provided stands.

Handicap Parking

Designated handicap parking is in front of the OB Library and the OB Senior Center joint lot.  This is a free lot.

Patrons of the Arts
How it works

The Patron program was created to provide committed support to the participating fine artists of the Orange Beach Festival of Art through dedicated funds which are used to purchase artwork during our annual show. This demonstrates to the artists our community’s commitment to the Festival and its artists, and in turn works to recruit both new and returning talent.  

You select your level of participation and donate those funds to Friends of the Arts. You receive two “Art Dollars” vouchers for use at the art festival to select your favorite piece(s). It’s a win-win-win: You are able to spend the majority of your dollars on original fine art; the fine artists are guaranteed committed interest in the festival and their work; and the portion retained by the Friends of the Arts directly funds our other show artists including performing artists and demonstrating artists.

Being a part of this dynamic group is both fun and rewarding through the numerous activities and events that the Friends help support at the Coastal Arts Center of Orange Beach, including:

The Festival of Art - second full weekend in March
Summer Art Camp/Teen Camp - June and July
CASA (Coastal Arts Student Academy) - September through April
Arts Afire fall festival - October
Frank Brown Int'l Songwriter's Festival - November
Light Up The Arts - December
Artist Receptions
Acoustic Arts Music Series

Hot Shop at Coastal Arts Center

Glass artists are working in the Hot Shop daily and you may watch demo's for free.  Established in 2009, the Coastal Arts Center's Hot Shop is Alabama's premier glass studio, and is open to the public Mon-Fri.

CLASSES (appointments required)
"Make Your Own" Glass Blowing Lessons: $95 (Min. age 8+ to blow glass) Offered M/T/TH/F at 9:30 a.m. Please arrive at 9:15 for your appointment. If you arrive after 9:30, it will be considered a missed appointment.
Private Glass Blowing Class: $225/hour (Pre-requisite is the Make Your Own class first.)
Sun Catcher Fused Glass Project: $45
Glass Fusing

(Prices subject to change.)

Credit card required to hold reservation.  Cancellations less than 24 hours out will result in being charged the $95 fee.

Appropriate Attire for Hot Shop
Closed-toe shoes required
Ages 8+ may participate
Cotton clothes are recommended. No synthetic materials.
Bring something to drink as we do not have vending machines on our campus.
Field Trips / Group Bookings / Corporate Demo's

Custom packages for group demo's are available.  Prices start at $185 for 45 minute demonstrations.  

Important Reminders

- We are a non-smoking facility.
- Children must be accompanied at all times.

- Artists break every day from noon to 1 pm. (Times may vary.)

- If you make an appointment to blow glass you are paying for an experience! No two pieces are alike and customers should expect variances in shape and size, especially with glass flowers.

- Your glass piece must slowly cool in the annealer for 24 hours before you take it home. The Arts Center offers shipping for certain items for those who are unable to return in 24 hours to pick up their work.- We pack our products with extra care and love... however, damage during shipping is not our responsibility.

Classes
"Make Your Own"

This class allows you to blow your own ornament, or sculpt a flower or paper weight from your choice of colors. You will work directly with a glass resident artist. Includes 30 minute live glass-blowing demonstration of ornament, flower and paperweight by our resident artists. Then choose which one you would like to create yourself! Classes last up to 2.5 hours depending on the number of participants.

Class sessions available at 9:30 am, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday
Session fee: $95 per person (Minimum Age 8+ to blow glass)
Cancellation Policy

Class space is limited. We hold reservations with a credit card. If you do not attend, and we do not receive notice of cancellation from you by noon the day prior to a class, you will be charged a fee of $95.

Private Glass Blowing Class

Building on the skills learned in Make Your Own classes, students will learn how to gather glass out of the furnace and reheat it. With ample instruction, students will make blown vessels from start to finish. Students will make approximately 2 to 3 pieces of beautiful glass art in this course. The artist will customize each class to meet the expectations of the student.

$225 per hour, per person (Minimum Age 8)
Important Reminders

If you make an appointment to blow glass, you are paying for an experience! No two pieces are alike, and customers should expect variances in shape and size, especially with glass flowers.

Your glass piece must slowly cool in the annealer for 24 hours before you take it home. The Arts Center offers shipping for certain items for those who are unable to return in 24 hours.

We pack our products with extra care and love. However, during the shipping process sometimes chips and other cosmetic issues can occur and would not be eligible for replacement.

Field Trips

The Hot Shop at the Coastal Arts Center of Orange Beach is a fully functional glass art studio where we enjoy sharing information about the art, science and history of glassblowing. Bring your organization or school for a fun and exciting presentation of glassblowing!

Guests will be introduced to:

The history of glass
Physical properties of glass
Reactions of organic and inorganic materials to extreme temperatures
Physical forces and the affect on molten glass
Application of science in a glass studio

The presentation is adapted to the age and/or grade level in order to remain age-appropriate. Glassblowing is an exciting and educational experience for both children and adults.

The cost of a Hot Shop field trip (demonstration only) is $175. Additional hands-on experience is available at a per person rate. Every Hot Shop field trip can be custom designed for your group depending on your number of guests. Call for details.

For more information please call 251-981-ARTS (2787).

Weddings & Events Space
SPACES

A perfect location for a destination wedding or corporate event featuring:

A gorgeous gallery space including a 5,000-square-foot main hall, a catering kitchen, and separate bride and groom dressing areas.
The waterfront grounds feature a stage overlooking Wolf Bay, lavish landscaping and moss draped oaks. 
The executive conference room is available for board meetings and small gatherings. This space offers a custom made 14 foot conference table with glass inlay. There is an adjacent room for overflow seating or for a refreshment area. The room also opens onto a large courtyard balcony with beautiful views of the property. Coffee/water service is available, and catering can be accommodated.
Custom tailored team-building retreats in The Hot Shop, Clay Studio and Gallery are available.
IMPORTANT INFO

Call for pricing information and availability.  Wedding dates are frequently booked a year in advance.

As a fine arts center we have other annual special events which affect availability, so please call as soon as possible to reserve your date. 

We do have specific policies regarding usage of the facility and a local wedding planner/director is required for large weddings as we do not have wedding planners on staff.

Municipal Election Information
Effective January 1, 2024, new Precinct 41 polling site.

Orange Beach Event Center
4671 Wharf Parkway West
Orange Beach, AL 36561

The Community Center is no longer the polling site. 

Please note: Ono Island residents: For all future elections, Ono Island residents will vote at Baldwin County Voting Precinct Number 51 at The Harriett Cockrell Center, 31692 Dolphin Drive. Ono Island is not part of the City of Orange Beach, it is in the unincorporated area of Baldwin County. The creation of the new precinct was approved by the Baldwin County Commission on July 20, 2021 (PDF).
